title: Command centre and client paperwork
notes: Replaced the manager home screen with a role-aware command centre focused on dispatch gaps, ticket review, billing readiness, A/R, timesheets, fleet availability and maintenance attention.
Updated the universal hamburger so accounting, safety, mechanic, dispatcher and supervisor accounts only see modules relevant to their role.
Added secure client access to approved field tickets through the existing client Tickets entry.
Clients can search approved field paperwork, review customer-facing work details and service rows, and view captured signatures.
Clients can print or save approved field tickets as clean PDF customer copies without exposing internal operator notes or pricing snapshots.
